meta.retention_definition: capacity_retention_5c = Q(5C_discharge, dfn) / Q(1C_discharge, dfn) with identical params, computed mechanically by the agent from two run-pyamm outputs and written to a derived JSON judged by log-evaluate.

objective_breakdown: ED>=446.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy contract) and 5C retention>=0.90 and mass<=40 g; expected trade-off: thicker/leaner stack raises ED but diffusion-limits 5C retention; porosity raises rate AND contract-ED (counted solid mass falls); mass set by area (ED area-independent)
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 + opening ceiling assessment; R2 lean-stack variants (thin CC 8/8 um, separator 10 um, porosity 0.40/0.30, particle radius 3 um); R3+ combine winners and tune thickness on ED x 5C Pareto; escalate to OKane2022 (SiOx negative) if Chen2020 ceiling < 446.18, LNMO as voltage-lever fallback; finalist -> 4C charge plating exam + 5C discharge thermal
budget_allocation: ~8 rounds: R1 baseline+ceiling, R2 lean variants, R3-4 Pareto/refine, R5 escalation if needed, R6 re-tune on new system, R7 safety, R8 closing; trim when converged
risk_and_fallback: ED ceiling short -> system escalation (OKane2022/LNMO); 5C retention fail -> smaller particles/higher porosity/electrolyte sigma-D-t+ overrides/thinner electrodes; mass>40 g -> thinner CC/separator then area scale-down; plating -> N/P adjust; T_max>333.15 -> cooling h up; solver errors recorded verbatim

detail: Opening ceiling assessment (Stage 3): levers assessed = current collectors (16/12um -> 8/6um), separator (12 -> 10um), porosity, particle radius, thickness/area. ED limit: lean-inert stack at baseline thickness = 17.414 Wh / ((0.16399+0.10588+0.00210+0.02160+0.05376) kg/m2 x 0.1027 m2) = 487.8 Wh/kg (mechanical layer math from calc-energy layer_kg_m2) > 446.18 -> ED NOT binding; gap to objective is architecture-side (rate capability 0.087 vs 0.90). Mass: lean inert -> ~35.7 g <= 40 g; area can be up-scaled to exactly 40 g after stack fix. Conclusion: no material escalation at opening; stay in Stage 3 (ceiling_escalation ON but assessment shows architecture space sufficient).
